title: Chapter 796
paragraphs: Chapter 796
Episode 196. The Great Snake, Ameris (5)
[You guys... yes, I had forgotten. You must be the Nameless Clan that I sealed right before I fell asleep. I suppose the seal was undone when I woke up.]

Jin looked curiously at the ancient Nameless Clan, who resembled his brethren but emanated an entirely different atmosphere. The only apparent difference between them and his brethren was the color of their cores and the aura they radiated.
'There are five of them... Their aura is red, that's unusual.'
The ancient Nameless Clan was also aware of Jin. It was because they sensed a similar energy coming from Jin, who appeared to be a human.
"Well, that happened. However, we've been waiting for you to create your avatar... We didn't expect you to already have friends."

The ancient Nameless Clan had been certain that Ameris would create an avatar as soon as they awakened. They knew well that her real body couldn't leave this place. They were sure that after so much time had passed, she would naturally create an avatar to investigate the situation.

"Besides, that human reeks just like us. It's very unpleasant... What is this? A legacy left by the Cheongmyeong Clan from that time? Considering his blue aura, he must be from the Cheongmyeong Clan."

The term 'Cheongmyeong Clan' was a designation used by the ancient Nameless Clan to refer to their kin who were on the opposite side in the past. The Jeokmyeong Clan and the Cheongmyeong Clan, these ancient Nameless Clan used to refer to each other that way. They had been at odds over the death and resurrection of the sun god, and over the sole ownership of the title 'Nameless King.'
"So I look like someone's legacy to you?"
"Well, even though the Cheongmyeong guys were inferior, they wouldn't be so stupid as to leave a mere human as their legacy. So, let me ask you one thing, lowly human. How did you get that power..."
Suddenly, five streaks of blue lightning fell, striking the ancient Nameless Clan. They quickly reacted and fended off the lightning, but they all blinked in surprise, their eyes wide open.

The ancient Nameless Clan was greatly shocked that a human had dared to attack them first without showing any fear. This was something that could never have happened in the world before they were sealed.
Above all,
The Jeokmyeong were feeling a shock as if their arms that blocked the lightning were falling off.
"Let me ask again, do I still look like a lowly human to you?"
The ancient Nameless Clan member who had been speaking arrogantly shut his mouth, suppressing his flustered expression.
"It seems not. In the current Nameless Clan, there are thirteen warrior-kings and one warrior-god."
"A system centered on the warrior-god and the warrior-kings has been maintained. Is that number based on the Cheongmyeong Clan's standards?"

The one standing in the center of the Jeokmyeong spoke. He, with the calmest eyes among them, was the leader of the group. When he opened his mouth, the tension among the other ancient Nameless Clan members, who seemed ready to spit out their objections at any moment, subsided.
"To Jin, he seemed to be the only one among the five ancient kings who faced reality.

"It's not the Qingming clan, but the Ming Wang clan. There are no known cases of the Ming Wang clan using red noreki, which no longer exists. It seems that they were opposed to the ancestors of my brother in the past, but as you can see, we are the only Ming Wang clan, and the Sun God you tried to resurrect is still the same. In other words, you could say you're defeated spirits."
"We're not dead yet, so we're not spirits. So, human Qingming clan, what's your hierarchy?"
"Thirteen Kings, successor to the God of War."

"Great. Including Ameris, there were many in our time who liked to package the lowly human race. Civilization is at a lower level and all weak and stupid as bugs, but they said there is infinite potential in the human race. It seems they were right. We failed, you survived."
"It's fortunate that you're not too arrogant for a failure."
"But now that we're awake, the war begins again. We plan to gather our compatriots from the present time and regain the lost status. We don't know who the final winner will be yet, do we?"
"You seem quite proud, at least enough to remember your name before the fight."
"Shimart, the one without a tribe. I am a first-class king of the Enemy clan."
As Shimart clearly recognized himself as a 'challenger', the other members of the Enemy clan looked back and forth between him and Jin.
However, the other members of the Enemy clan soon had no choice but to introduce themselves like Shimart. It was natural since Shimart had acknowledged the enemy as a strong man.
"......Makiram Jung. A warrior of the Jung tribe, I'm a second-class king of the Enemy clan."
"Manta Hon. A warrior of the Hon tribe, I'm a second-class king of the Enemy clan."
"Andollin Hon. A warrior of the Hon tribe, I'm a second-class king of the Enemy clan."
"Ogen Kam. A warrior of the Kam tribe, I'm a second-class king of the Enemy clan!"

"Remember. I am Jin Run Kandel, as I said before, one of the thirteen kings of the Ming Wang clan, and the master of Run Kandel. Feel free to attack from now on. You can use Ameris crudely, and it's okay to target my colleagues. However, each time, mercy will be reduced."
Jin winked at Hedo. It meant to protect Ameris and his colleagues.
"Wait outside, Jin."
"Let's kill them all."
"Don't get hurt."

[It seems that these guys have also been weakened a lot due to the aftermath of the seal, like me. You guys are unlucky, having met this kid as soon as you came out. If you had kept hiding, you could have enjoyed the ground a little.]
While Hedo and his colleagues were preparing to climb the cliff of the pit, there was not a single attack between Jin and the Enemy clan.
The cautiousness of Shimart was the reason. While talking to Jin, he read his energy, and determined that they could not handle Jin at his current state.
'Before being sealed, even when my brothers and I had our full strength, it was a bit... No, it could have been impossible for us to confront him.'
Jin saw right through him and smiled.
And then, he disappeared from the enemy's view in a flash, striking down Sigmund like a whip.
"Ugh!"

"If you keep being quiet just because it's hard to calculate the gap, even though I've made the first move, it's not right. If they were my brothers, even the weakest soldier would never stop thinking. After all, if the opponent is stronger, it's the most honorable to fight and eventually break."
Every time Sigmund fell to the enemies, a thunderous sound that shook the entire sky spread. The enemies desperately defended themselves against the blows full of Jin's power with their weapons.
'...He summoned the sword not from a scabbard, but from a bracelet?'
On closer inspection, they all wore golden bracelets, from which the weapons were emerging.
When he broke Andolin's sword with a test attack, Andolin immediately retreated to the defensive and drew a new sword from his bracelet.
'An artifact, huh? I need to get one.'

Despite being greatly weakened due to the seal, the enemies moved exceptionally well. Their teamwork was perfect as if they had always fought together, and each of them had reached a high level of skill. From their crimson hearts, which glowed like pure blood, sharp and fierce thunderbolts poured out relentlessly.
"In your prime, you lived up to the name of the king. But your mindset is not like my brothers. Your swordsmanship is... calculative."
"Whether it's calculative or not. Only the stronger ones have value. When the screams of the enemy start to engulf the world again, even you will have to calculate, Thirteen Tugwang of Cheongmyeong."
Slash!
The first to lose a limb was Makiram. Before Makiram could escape under cover, Jin executed the Nine Swords Extermination and cut off his breath.
"Makiram!"
At Makiram's death, Manta threw himself at his corpse as if he had lost his mind.
'You should have fought more calmly, why do this?'
While it was strange, Jin first slashed Manta who had left a gap.
"Cough...!"
Despite their weakness, the enemies were not weak at all. It just seemed that way because Jin was confronting them with his full power.

'After the deaths of Makiram and Manta, Shimart's movements have become overly simplistic. It seems like he's trying to pull some trick. Manta's actions were also unnatural, as if it was his turn to die after Makiram. What is he trying to achieve by using his comrades' lives like tools...?'
It was highly likely to be either a suicide attack or an escape.
Jin made that judgement and glared at Shimart.

"Shimart. What are you preparing for, even abandoning Makiram and Manta? You seem to call each other kin, not brothers, is it due to a lack of camaraderie, or is the hierarchy so severe? Both of them outright threw their lives as if it was their turn."
Jin's voice was tinged with anger.
Even the enemies were clearly of the same roots as the King's Clan, such an act was unimaginable for the brothers of Lafrarosa.
"Whatever it is, I hope that your disgusting action has its worth. It's disgusting to even think that we share the same roots."
Shimart's eyes widened. He didn't expect Jin to realize that the deaths of Makiram and Manta were intentional. They didn't exchange a single glance to plan.
The sacrifice of the two was agreed upon since the ancient times when they fought together on the battlefield.
Grrr-!
Jin, who deployed the Jujitsu of the Martial King, Judgment, narrowed the distance by shattering the enemies' shield. The shield couldn't recover from the aura of Judgment and kept breaking.
"Kaak...!"
Ozen, the weakest among the remaining enemies, couldn't withstand the shockwave and bled from all the orifices on his face. Shimart and Andollin blocked him.
"Martial King of Qingming, you said earlier that it's honorable to break while fighting a stronger opponent. However, true honor is surviving by any means and seizing victory."
Hearing that, Jin narrowed his brows in annoyance.
'So, they were planning to escape. I didn't completely corner them as I wanted to keep one or two alive for information. Can they teleport?'
If the opponent said that, it means they've finished preparing to escape.
Without further thought, Jin exploded with energy, intending to turn them into ashes instantly. It would be better than letting them escape, even if he couldn't get any information.
But as Jin predicted, Shimart was already prepared, sacrificing Makiram and Manta.
Sigmund cut down the remaining enemies.
However, there was no sensation of flesh and bones on the blade. The remaining enemies were quickly becoming transparent. They were disappearing like afterimages.
"Tell your kindred, the enemies have returned. The fate of Ameris will also end this time."
Even while turning transparent, Shimart spat a warning at Jin with eyes filled with resentment.

Looking at where the corpses of Makiram and Manta were, their red heartlights were burning like fire. The remaining enemies seemed to use the heartlights of the two as a sacrifice, like casting black magic.
"You have shown your despicable sides and lost my mercy. If we meet next time, you'll regret not dying today, so hide well and live."
Jin responded like that before Shimart and the remaining enemies completely disappeared.
